scripts.check: bun run check:effect && bun run check:effect-diagnostics && biome check . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.workers.json && bun run check:binding-contract && bun run lint:deps && bun run lint:http-boundary && bun run check:migrations:worktree && bun run check:fresh && bun run verify:api-client
scripts.check:effect-diagnostics: bun scripts/ensure-tsgo-executable.mjs && bunx effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.json --format text --strict --severity error && bunx effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.workers.json --format text --strict --severity error
scripts.test: bun test packages apps scripts && bun run test:workerd
scripts.test:workerd: vitest run --config tests/workerd/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/workerd-http/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/workerd-self/vitest.config.ts
